title: Sole traders
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:47Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point is a Year 11 card that covers sole traders and partnerships together, using legal terms like unincorporated, separate legal entity and unlimited liability, which is too deep for a Year 7 point on sole traders alone.

draft.title: Sole traders
card: One person who owns and runs a business. Examples are a plumber, a hairdresser or a person who sells crafts at a market.
A sole trader keeps all the profit the business makes, because there are no other owners to share it with.
A sole trader is personally responsible for all the business's debts. If the business cannot pay what it owes, the owner's own money and belongings may be used to pay.
The owner makes all the decisions. A sole trader may hire workers, but the business still has only one owner.
draft.remember: One owner gets all the profit and carries all the debts.

a.q: Tom runs a lawn mowing business on his own in Cairns. Who is responsible if the business cannot pay its debts?
opts: Tom, with his own money and belongings
Only the customers who ordered mowing
Only the business, not Tom himself
Tom and anyone who works for him
a.why: A sole trader is personally responsible for all the business's debts, so Tom's own money and belongings may be used. Workers are not owners, so they do not share the debts.
a.clue: Think about who owns the business.

b.q: Priya runs a café in Hobart by herself and hires three workers. Her café makes a good profit this year. Who is entitled to keep the profit?
opts: Priya, because she is the only owner
Priya and her three workers equally
The workers, because they serve customers
Nobody, until the debts are all paid off
b.why: A sole trader has one owner, and she keeps all the profit. Hiring workers does not make them owners, so they are paid wages but do not share the profit. Debts do not stop the owner keeping profit.
b.clue: Does paying workers make them owners?

a.best: Tom, with his own money and belongings

b.best: Priya, because she is the only owner
